visual_identity.core_identity: A wormlike ambush predator with a thick segmented body and four fleshy tentacles opening around a hard central beak.
visual_identity.silhouette: Thick serpentine body coiled or rising, front end opening into four evenly spaced tentacles around the mouth.
visual_identity.head_features: No normal head; four muscular facial tentacles frame a small hard beak at the exact center.
visual_identity.body_shape: Long heavy worm body with subtle segmented folds and no legs.
visual_identity.surface: Rubbery ringed skin with restrained segment lines.
visual_identity.limb_structure: No walking legs or arms. Exactly four fleshy facial tentacles open symmetrically around one small central beak at the front of the long wormlike body.
visual_identity.shape_lock: Draw one thick legless worm body with a single front end that opens into exactly four muscular tentacles around one central beak. Keep the rest of the body continuous, heavy, and serpentine; add no snake head, octopus body, insect legs, or extra facial tentacles.

reference.notes: Reference material controls creature identity, anatomy, and silhouette only; Black-Ink controls the final coloring-book rendering style.
